- **Interquartile Range (IQR)**: The IQR is the range between the first quartile (25th percentile) and the third quartile (75th percentile). It is not affected by outliers because it only considers the middle 50% of the data.

- **Harmonic Mean**: The harmonic mean is the reciprocal of the arithmetic mean of the reciprocals. It is highly sensitive to outliers, especially small ones.
- **Root Mean Square (RMS)**: The RMS is the square root of the mean of the squares of the values. It is more sensitive to outliers than the arithmetic mean because squaring amplifies the effect of large values.
